svg.text: 2026-11-18 NIGHT ROUND 12 (CUMULATIVE R492) · MULTI-IM BRIDGE, DSH SUITE & PRECOMPUTED CONTEXT PACKS
earayu/Mingle (★50 Multi-IM) + dsh-cdx-plus (20 Plugins) + devkb (-55% Cost) + sksareen/point
1. earayu/Mingle (★50 · 5 forks · Zero-Server Bridge · MIT)
• One Agent, Every Chat App, One Shared Local Memory
Feishu, WeChat, WeCom, DingTalk, Slack, Discord, Telegram, GitHub PRs & iMessage
Driven by local Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, DSH & Antigravity via OAR ($0 markup)
2. Asuta/dsh-cdx-plus v0.1.10 (★28 · 20 DSH Plugins · MIT)
• Multi-snippet Selection Quotes & Inline Annotations before sending
• Context-inheriting Side Chats + .worktreeinclude Git Worktree Environments
• Scoped /review subagent code review + guanhaisen/dsh-agent-browser sidebar
• All 20 sub-plugins individually toggleable on DeepSeek Harness >= 0.2.2-rc.2
3. namiq-ai/devkb (★9 · Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.24267143 · Apache-2.0)
• Precomputed Context Packs: 55% Cheaper ($0.070 ➔ $0.025) & 0.981 Quality
Plain search $0.070 (0.931) ➔ 12 tools $0.059 ➔ 7 tools $0.040 ➔ devkb pack $0.025 (0.981)
Combines AST (Python/C#/C++/TS) + Git history; flags unresolved calls as Incomplete
4. sksareen/point (★9 · macOS 26 On-Device SpeechAnalyzer · MIT)
• Hold Right Option + talk + draw a loop around any screen element
• Hands web chats the annotated image & CLI/IDE agents (Claude/Cursor) the file path
• 100% on-device SpeechAnalyzer transcription (0 audio leaves the Mac)
• Includes a double-tap 1,440-character floating sticky pad for quick voice notes
